events.title: Demo Out Now 🌻🐝✨
events.summary: Hello bzzz 🐝The demo is now available 💐Become the florist of the Atrium in this demo of 12 levels to solve and about 1 hour of content.A marriage proposal? A bouquet to treat yourself? Celebrating a birth or the success of loved ones? Every situation comes with different requirements: roses and sense of affection for a romantic bouquet. events.title: Demo Date Announced 📅🐝✨
events.summary: We announced a few weeks ago in our latest trailer (have you seen it?)The demo of I can offer you Flowers will release on Steam on October 19th, 2026!Some amazing streamers already went live on the game, and I feel at ease to say:We have put our best efforts and love into this demo. I’m so eager to get your feedback and reviews of the game 💞You can play in English or French for now.See you Monday 🌻
